[ BIOGRAPHY ]

Short form

Bollam Rishithej is an Indian deep-tech founder and operator, and Managing Director of ML Dynamic Solutions. He is a director and co-founder across VidyuthLabs, Predictera, FirstSecure.ai and DenyFix.ai, and holds board positions across ML Capital, CXOera and four industrial companies. He holds an MSc in Advanced Mechanical Engineering with Management from the University of Leicester.

Designation

Founder & Managing Director, ML Dynamic Solutions.

Location

Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
